promotion.name: HFW
promotion.blurb: Every legend of the business, back as they were at their best. A dream promotion run out of a museum, with a hall of fame that catches fire every time somebody gets inducted.

roster.gimmick: A deeply tanned, permanently flexing icon who tells children to say their prayers, eat their vitamins and buy his frying pan. He has headlined for thirty years and has never once been seen losing clean.
roster.catchphrase: What'cha gonna do, little brother, when the bronze rubs off on YOU?
roster.finisher_description: He cups a hand to his ear for a full minute, rips his shirt in two, and drops a slow, flat leg across the throat.

roster.gimmick: A bald, foul-tempered roofer who hates authority, paperwork and anyone in a suit. He drinks room-temperature soda by the crate because the cooler is always broken.
roster.catchphrase: That's the bottom of the cooler, and it's WARM!
roster.finisher_description: A kick to the gut, a quarter turn and a jaw-jolting drop to the seat, then two cans of flat soda over the body.

roster.gimmick: A towering funeral director for hire who has died eleven times and comes back every spring with a longer entrance.
roster.finisher_description: He turns his victim upside down, sits them into a piledriver with their arms crossed, rolls his own eyes back, and leaves a bill.

roster.gimmick: A film star who sits on the giant's board, raises one eyebrow, and comes back to wrestle when a sequel needs promoting.
roster.finisher: The Super Cool Basic Elbow Drop
roster.finisher_description: A slow, theatrical elbow drop after throwing off one elbow pad.

finishing_moves.name: The Super Cool Basic Elbow Drop

roster.gimmick: A seventy-seven-year-old dirty player in a forty-thousand-dollar robe who still struts, still chops and still owes everybody money.
roster.catchphrase: Robes. Money. Chops. In that order.
roster.finisher_description: A figure-four leg lock, robe still on.

roster.gimmick: A born-again showstopper who flew around rings for thirty years and now trains the next ones while preaching.
roster.catchphrase: I've got heart. Mine broke twice.
roster.finisher_description: A superkick preceded by stomping the mat to wind up the crowd.

roster.gimmick: A lovable madman who fell off a cell, wrote three books about it, and keeps a sock puppet in his tights.
roster.finisher_description: A mandible claw with a sock puppet on the hand.

roster.gimmick: An Olympic champion with a broken neck who repeats everything three times, intensely.
roster.finisher_description: An ankle lock held on the mat.

roster.gimmick: A bald powerhouse who won his first hundred and seventy-three matches and still counts out loud as he walks to the ring.
roster.finisher_description: A spear followed by a jackhammer suplex.

roster.gimmick: A five-time champion now on commentary, who stops mid-sentence to spin on his back.
roster.catchphrase: Five times, five times, five... I lost count.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning back-to-the-mat taunt, then an axe kick.

roster.gimmick: A fitness legend who made the women's division matter and comes back for one more every couple of years.
roster.finisher_description: A headscissors into a bulldog.

roster.gimmick: A punk-rock flyer who changed women's wrestling, then the music business, then came back.
roster.finisher_description: A moonsault.

roster.gimmick: Pink and black from the boots to the sunglasses, which he hands to a child in the front row every single night. Best there is, best there was, best there ever will be at complaining about a referee.
roster.catchphrase: I am the best there is at most of this.
roster.finisher_description: He folds both legs into a knot, steps over, and sits down until the other person reconsiders their life.

roster.gimmick: A gravel-voiced man in neon fringe, a cowboy hat and wraparound shades who talks about vegetables as if they were religion. He climbs to the top rope as if it owes him money.
roster.finisher: The Elbow From Very High Up
roster.finisher_description: He climbs every turnbuckle there is, points at the sky for longer than is safe, and drops an elbow from orbit.

signatures.name: Rope Hang Throat Drop
signatures.move: Throat drop on the top rope

signatures.name: Double Axe From the Top
signatures.move: Double axe handle off the top

finishing_moves.name: The Elbow From Very High Up

roster.gimmick_category: The Eighth Wonder of the Buffet
roster.gimmick: The biggest man anybody has ever seen, who has never paid for a meal or a drink and never will. He sits on people. That is the whole plan, and it has never failed.
roster.finisher_description: He walks over, turns round, and sits down on the other person. The referee counts to three out of respect.

roster.gimmick: The cleanest wrestler in history, who breathes steam on the way to the ring and has never once bent a rule. Parents trust him with their children and their kettles.
roster.finisher_description: A diving crossbody off the top rope, as smooth as a boiled egg.

roster.gimmick: A bagpipe-playing loudmouth in a kilt who hosts a talk show on the apron and breaks a coconut on his guests. Just when they think they have the answers, he changes the plumbing.
roster.catchphrase: Just when you think you have the answers, I change the pipes.
roster.finisher_description: A sleeper hold from behind, held until the arm drops three times and the bagpipes start.

roster.gimmick: He sprints to the ring, shakes the ropes until they cry, and speaks in riddles about destiny, spaceships and electrolytes. Nobody has ever finished one of his interviews.
roster.catchphrase: Feel the power of the hydration!
roster.finisher_description: He lifts them high over his head, holds them there for a breath, then drops them and follows with a splash.

roster.gimmick: A grinning, shoulder-shimmying technician who lies, cheats and borrows your car, then gives it back washed. The crowd loves him for every lie.
roster.catchphrase: I lie, I cheat, I return the car with a full tank.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash from the top rope, the one thing he never fakes.

signatures.name: Chair Toss Alibi
signatures.move: Throws a chair to a fallen opponent and plays dead

roster.gimmick_category: The Common Man in Polka Dots
roster.gimmick: The son of a plumber who talks about hard times as if he invented them, in yellow polka dots, with a jab he calls a ballet. Wears his heart on his sleeve and gravy on his shirt.
roster.catchphrase: Hard times are real, and so are these polka dots.
roster.finisher_description: He wiggles his hips, shuffles his feet, then drops an elbow on the top of the head.

roster.ring_name: Harley Raceway, King of the Pit Stop
roster.gimmick_category: The Toughest Man at the Track
roster.gimmick: Eight-time world champion of whatever was on that weekend, he wears a crown, a robe and the expression of a man who has never lost a bar fight.
roster.catchphrase: Kneel before the king of the pit stop.
roster.finisher_description: He dives off the top rope head first. He is not well. Neither is the other person.

look.name: Harley Raceway, King of the Pit Stop

roster.gimmick: A barrel-chested strongman who held the big belt for eight years and has eaten the same lunch every day of them. Sold out the Garden two hundred times. The Garden still smells of salami.
roster.finisher: The Bear Hug of the Garden
roster.finisher_description: A bear hug that lasts until the other person agrees to share their lunch.

finishing_moves.name: The Bear Hug of the Garden

roster.gimmick: The man every hold is named after, according to him. He has a footnote for every move and corrects the referee's grammar. Undefeated in debates.
roster.finisher_description: A leaping body press that knocks them flat, followed by a long list of punches, each one with a reference.

roster.gimmick: A wild Texan who has retired nine times, each time with a farewell match and a comeback a month later. Swings a branding iron and a ladder, often at once.
roster.catchphrase: This is my last match. Again.
roster.finisher: The Spinning Toe Hold of Retirement
roster.finisher_description: A spinning toe hold, spun until the boot comes off.

finishing_moves.name: The Spinning Toe Hold of Retirement

roster.gimmick: He does everything perfectly in short films: golf, bowling, basketball, catching his own gum. In the ring he is almost as perfect, and he will tell you the almost is a typo.
roster.finisher_description: A bridging fisherman's suplex held so neatly the referee asks for his autograph.

roster.gimmick: The youngest of a wrestling family, who is sick of standing in his big brother's shadow and says so in every interview. Nobody has ever been more fun to boo.
roster.catchphrase: Enough is enough, and it is time for a change.
roster.finisher_description: The family leg hold, done with a little more spite.

roster.gimmick: Seven feet of too cool to bother, he leans on the ropes and stretches his back while his opponents tire themselves out. Has a nacho flavour named after him by nobody.
roster.catchphrase: Too sweet. Too cool. Too ranch.
roster.finisher_description: A powerbomb from a great height, sat down on with arms crossed.

roster.gimmick_category: The Bad Guy With a Toothpick
roster.gimmick: A slicked-back tough guy with a toothpick, a gold chain and an accent he picked up from a film. He flicks the toothpick at people who disappoint him. Most people disappoint him.
roster.catchphrase: Say hello to the bad guy, chico.
roster.finisher_description: He lifts them up on his shoulders, shows them to all four sides of the building, and drops them flat.

roster.ring_name: Stung, the Man in the Rafters
roster.gimmick_category: The Silent Crow in the Rafters
roster.gimmick: Once a bleach-blond surfer, now a silent man in white face paint and a trench coat who lowers himself from the ceiling with a baseball bat. He has not said a word in eighteen months, and the crowd hangs on every one of them.
roster.finisher_description: A leg lock that bends them the wrong way, held until they tap or apologise to the surfer he used to be.

look.name: Stung, the Man in the Rafters

roster.gimmick_category: The Largest Athlete in Any Room
roster.gimmick: The biggest man in any building he walks into, who has turned good and bad more times than anybody can count and shrugs at every one of them.
roster.catchphrase: I am the biggest thing in this room, and I am tired.
roster.finisher_description: He grabs a throat with one hand and slams them down from seven feet up.

roster.gimmick: A masked monster who sets fire to the ring posts on the way out and the town council on the way home. He has run for office twice and won both times.
roster.finisher: The Tombstone of the Tax Office
roster.finisher_description: He turns them upside down, holds them against his chest, and kneels.

finishing_moves.name: The Tombstone of the Tax Office

roster.gimmick: A tattooed bodybuilder who poses in the middle of the ring with fireworks going off behind him, then destroys whoever is there. Collects toys between matches.
roster.catchphrase: I am the Animal Cracker. Fear the crumbs.
roster.finisher_description: A sit-out powerbomb, then two thumbs: up, then down.

roster.gimmick: A relaxed flyer who points at his own name with both thumbs and does the splits on chairs. He is never in a hurry and always somehow on time.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash from the top rope that covers half the ring.
roster.finisher_move: Frog splash from the top rope

roster.gimmick: A huge, tattooed-headed brawler who moves like a cruiserweight and eats like three. Flames on his head, crumbs on his chest.
roster.finisher_description: A diving headbutt from the top rope by a man who should not be able to get up there.

roster.gimmick: A masked mountain who wears a smoking headpiece to the ring, calls himself the leader of everything, and moonsaults off the top rope at four hundred pounds.
roster.finisher_description: A splash from the second rope that registers on the local earthquake monitor.

roster.gimmick: A huge sumo grand champion who throws salt before every match and has secretly taken up dance classes. He never moves his feet in the ring, only out of it.
roster.finisher_description: He climbs to the second rope and sits down on the other person from a great height.
roster.finisher_move: Seated senton from the second rope

roster.gimmick: A huge-hearted brawler who walks to the ring with a chain round his neck and crawls round it on all fours, headbutting anybody who will let him.
roster.finisher_description: A powerslam with a little dance after it.

roster.gimmick: A soft-spoken menace who brings a python to the ring in a sack and the most frightening whisper in wrestling. Never shouts. Never needs to.
roster.catchphrase: Trust me. That is the problem.
roster.finisher_description: He wraps an arm round the head and falls back, and the lights go out.

roster.ring_name: Ted Debitbiase, the Million-ish Dollar Man
roster.gimmick: A rich man in a sequined suit, a long-suffering valet and a gold belt he bought himself. He pays children to stop dribbling basketballs.
roster.catchphrase: Everybody has a price. Mine is on credit.
roster.finisher_description: A cobra clutch, applied while laughing, until they sell.

look.name: Ted Debitbiase, the Million-ish Dollar Man

roster.gimmick: A big-hearted hoss with a flag in one hand and a plank of wood in the other, who shouts one word at the crowd and the crowd always shouts it back.
roster.finisher_description: A running three-point clothesline, with the plank somewhere nearby.

roster.gimmick: A powerful Englishman in Union-flag tights who walks a real bulldog to the ring. The bulldog has more fans than he does and has never let it go to its head.
roster.finisher_description: He carries them across the ring at a sprint and drops them on their back.

roster.gimmick: A tiny, wiry, terrifying Englishman who throws himself off everything as if he has a spare body at home.
roster.finisher_description: A diving headbutt off the top rope, the whole length of the ring.

roster.ring_name: Barn Andersen, the Enforcer of Paperwork
roster.gimmick: The quietest member of the gang, who does the dirty work and the filing. He has never been in a hurry and has never missed a deadline or a spinebuster.
roster.finisher_description: He catches them running and drops them on their back in one smooth motion, like a drawer slamming.

look.name: Barn Andersen, the Enforcer of Paperwork

roster.gimmick: A sneering sharpie who wrestles in a three-piece suit to the ring and always seems to have a roll of coins in his fist.
roster.catchphrase: I do not get paid enough for this.
roster.finisher_description: A slingshot suplex from the apron back into the ring.

roster.gimmick_category: The Cowboy Who Never Got His Moment
roster.gimmick: A tall, gifted cowboy who could have been the biggest star in the world and keeps being the best man at somebody else's wedding.
roster.finisher: The Superplex From the Old Barn
roster.finisher_description: A superplex from the top rope that shakes the whole building.

finishing_moves.name: The Superplex From the Old Barn

roster.gimmick: A chiselled bodybuilder who poses in the mirror on the way to the ring and has had a metal plate in his arm since the incident with the aeroplane.
roster.finisher_description: He lifts them across his shoulders and bends them until they give up.

roster.gimmick: A former nightclub manager who started wrestling at thirty-five, found yoga, and now finishes everybody out of nowhere with a smile and a self high-five.
roster.finisher_description: Out of nowhere, a cutter that brings them face first to the mat.

roster.gimmick_category: The Man of a Thousand Hold Music
roster.gimmick: A silent, blank-faced technician who knows every hold there is and has never once smiled on camera. They call him the man of a thousand holds; he only ever uses the last one.
roster.finisher_description: He crosses both legs, turns them over and sits back, with the face of a man paying a gas bill.

roster.gimmick_category: The Masked Dragon Who Is Running Late
roster.gimmick: A masked flyer who trained in Mexico and Japan and wears a different mask for every country. He is always a little late, and nobody minds.
roster.finisher_description: He runs up the ropes, turns in the air and drives them head first with an inverted DDT.

roster.gimmick: A full-body-suited flyer with horns on his head and flowers on his trunks, who screams at the start of every match and invented half the junior heavyweight division by accident.
roster.finisher_description: A sit-out powerbomb, then a scream.

roster.gimmick: A quiet ace in green who barely changes his expression and throws the most beautiful rolling elbow ever thrown. Long matches, short speeches, no wasted motion.
roster.finisher_description: He lifts them on his shoulder, turns, and drives them down with a side slam.

roster.gimmick: A bleached-haired powerhouse in orange whose chest is permanently red from chops, his and everybody else's. Crowds count his chops out loud.
roster.finisher_description: An inverted fireman's carry dropped head first, a move he only uses on the biggest of nights.

roster.gimmick: A grumpy kicker who boots his opponents in the face, then stands over them with his arms folded, deciding whether to bother finishing.
roster.finisher_description: He sits on the back of the neck and pulls up an arm until they give up or pass out.

roster.gimmick: A legendary ace with a famous chin, who once fought a boxer for an hour lying on his back and slaps people to give them fighting spirit, whether they want it or not.
roster.catchphrase: Fighting spirit! Here, have a slap.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning kick to the back of the head that he swears was a sneeze.

roster.gimmick: The tallest man in Japan, who talks without stopping and moves like a slow-motion replay. Founded a company to have someone to talk to.
roster.catchphrase: Let me tell you about my day.
roster.finisher_description: A big boot that seems to take a full minute to arrive and lands anyway.

roster.gimmick: A fine technician who invented so many dragon moves that he now needs a lie-down after each one.
roster.finisher_description: He hooks the head from behind, arches back and holds on until somebody falls asleep, usually not him.

roster.gimmick_category: The Painted Dog of the Mist
roster.gimmick: A face-painted mystery who spits green mist into people's eyes and moonsaults with knees that should have retired years ago.
roster.finisher_description: A moonsault from the top rope after a mouthful of green mist.

roster.gimmick: A shiny-haired ace who plays air guitar after every win and says the company will be fine for a hundred years. He has said it for twenty.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash from the top rope, finished with a guitar solo.

roster.gimmick_category: The Silver Mask of the Cinema
roster.gimmick: A silver-masked hero who stars in films about fighting vampires on his days off and has never been seen without the mask, not even at breakfast.
roster.finisher_description: He stands on their back, pulls both arms and bends them like a surfboard.

roster.gimmick_category: The Man of a Thousand Mascots
roster.gimmick: A masked flyer who wears a different mask to the ring every night and sells a matching soft toy of each one.
roster.finisher: The Flying Body Press of a Thousand Masks
roster.finisher_description: A diving crossbody from the top rope, mask first.

finishing_moves.name: The Flying Body Press of a Thousand Masks

roster.gimmick: A blue-masked master of holds who runs a wrestling school between matches and demonstrates every move on whoever is standing nearest.
roster.catchphrase: Watch closely. There will be a test.
roster.finisher_description: He kneels on their back and pulls the head and the leg back like a bow.

roster.gimmick: An Olympic weightlifter who once lifted a house and is still paying for it. When he is in the mood, he hurts people and makes them sign the papers.
roster.catchphrase: That's what I do. Mostly lifting.
roster.finisher: The World's Strongest Slam (of the Week)
roster.finisher_description: A front powerslam from somebody who could lift the whole ring.

finishing_moves.name: The World's Strongest Slam (of the Week)

roster.gimmick: A huge, dancing Samoan in a thong who delivers groceries, people and his backside to anybody stuck in the corner.
roster.finisher_description: He backs the other person into the corner, runs, and sits on their face.
roster.finisher_move: Running butt splash in the corner

roster.gimmick: A mohawked, face-painted bruiser with spiked shoulder pads who worries about the road conditions and then runs over everybody in his way.
roster.finisher_description: His partner lifts the opponent on his shoulders, and he flies off the top rope with a clothesline.

roster.gimmick_category: The Other Half of the Road Worriers
roster.gimmick: The quieter, broader half of the team, with a mohawk, face paint and spiked shoulder pads. He drives the van and worries about the road the most.
roster.finisher_description: He lifts the opponent on his shoulders for his partner's flying clothesline.

roster.gimmick_category: Half of the Rock and Roll Expressway
roster.gimmick: A mulleted underdog who gets beaten up for twenty minutes every night until the crowd is ready to riot, then tags out. The ladies scream; the bank calls.
roster.finisher_description: A rolling cradle out of nowhere.

roster.gimmick_category: The Other Half of the Rock and Roll Expressway
roster.gimmick: The other half of the team, who waits on the apron for the hot tag and then cleans house, saying things nobody can quite make out.
roster.catchphrase: Hot tag, hot tag, hot tag!
roster.finisher_description: A running bulldog that sends them face first into the canvas.

roster.gimmick: A former college football and amateur star built like a tractor, who collects on his debts personally and with a running powerslam.
roster.finisher_description: A running powerslam that carries them half the length of the ring.

roster.gimmick: A shaven-headed Cold War villain with a fake accent and a real lariat, who still thinks it is 1985.
roster.catchphrase: The Cold War is not over in my heart.
roster.finisher_description: A running lariat with the whole arm.

roster.gimmick: A former Olympic grappler with curled-toe boots and Persian clubs who spits on the floor, insults every city he visits, and is loved for it.
roster.catchphrase: Make them humble. Then make them a smoothie.
roster.finisher_description: He sits on their back, pulls up the chin, and rocks.

roster.gimmick_category: The Drill Sergeant on a Break
roster.gimmick: A barking drill sergeant in a campaign hat who orders the crowd to do push-ups and never does any himself.
roster.catchphrase: Drop and give me twenty. I will watch.
roster.finisher_description: He wraps an arm round the head from behind and squeezes until they salute.

roster.gimmick: A golden-haired Texan heartthrob from a famous wrestling family, who runs to the ring as if the building is on fire and grips heads with one hand.
roster.finisher_description: He grips the top of the head with one hand and squeezes them down to the mat.

roster.ring_name: Kevin Von Errand, the Barefoot Brother
roster.gimmick: The eldest brother, who wrestles barefoot because he forgot his boots once and it felt right. He flies like nobody his size ever has.
roster.catchphrase: Shoes are optional. The claw is not.
roster.finisher_description: The family claw hold, applied with bare feet planted.

look.name: Kevin Von Errand, the Barefoot Brother

roster.gimmick_category: The Flying Forearm of the People
roster.gimmick: A tireless, smiling worker who shouts one word to the crowd at every match and gives every opponent a forearm they remember.
roster.finisher_description: A leaping forearm smash to the jaw.

roster.gimmick: A grim brawler with forearms like a sledgehammer and a soft spot for greetings cards. He sends one to every opponent after he breaks their leg.
roster.catchphrase: Roses are red, so is your shin.
roster.finisher_description: A figure-four leg lock, held with a romantic look on his face.

roster.gimmick: A fitness-obsessed boy scout of a champion who does lunges between every move and snaps if anybody calls him old.
roster.catchphrase: Lunge with me, or face the chicken wing.
roster.finisher_description: He hooks an arm behind the back and wrenches it up while cranking the face.

roster.gimmick: A silver-haired champion with an enormous vocabulary who talks his opponents into exhaustion before he ever touches them.
roster.catchphrase: Your vocabulary is as limited as your offence.
roster.finisher_description: A piledriver, followed by a definition of the word piledriver.

roster.gimmick: A platinum-curled dandy who has his valet spray perfume on the ring before he will step into it, and throws golden hairpins to the crowd.
roster.catchphrase: Spray the ring. Then we talk.
roster.finisher: The Flying Side Headlock of Perfume
roster.finisher_description: A flying headlock takedown in a cloud of scent.

finishing_moves.name: The Flying Side Headlock of Perfume

roster.ring_name: Buddy Rodger-That, the Original Nature Kid
roster.gimmick: The first man to strut, to shout and to dye his hair platinum for the cameras. Everybody since has borrowed something from him, and he keeps a list.
roster.catchphrase: To a nice guy, a list of debts.
roster.finisher_description: A figure-four leg lock, in black and white.

look.name: Buddy Rodger-That, the Original Nature Kid

roster.gimmick: A moustached Romeo in airbrushed tights with his own face on the bum, who stops the music to tell the crowd how unattractive they are, then swivels his hips.
roster.finisher_description: A pumphandle neckbreaker, and then a hip swivel over the body.

roster.gimmick_category: Master and Ruler of the Sandbox
roster.gimmick: A towering, wild-eyed powerbomber who calls himself the master and ruler of the world and will not be told about other planets.
roster.catchphrase: I am the master and the ruler of the sandbox!
roster.finisher_description: A powerbomb from as high as he can reach, which is very high.

roster.gimmick: The barking, headgear-wearing older brother, a real amateur wrestler who greets everybody, including the opponent, with a bark.
roster.finisher_description: A bulldog off the top rope, with a bark.

roster.gimmick: A gigantic-armed muscleman in chainmail headgear who explains his chances of winning with mathematics nobody can follow, and push-ups everybody can.
roster.catchphrase: My chances are one hundred and forty-one per cent.
roster.finisher_description: He sits on their back and pulls the chin back with a choke.

roster.gimmick: A brooding grunge poet in a leather jacket and a cut-off skirt who leads a gang of misfits and recites poems about his childhood between chair shots.
roster.catchphrase: Quoth the Crowven: nevermore, unless the money is right.
roster.finisher_description: A DDT that leaves them in a heap, followed by a poem.

signatures.name: Drop Toe Hold on a Chair
signatures.move: Drop toe hold onto a chair

finishing_moves.name: Drop Toe Hold on a Chair

roster.gimmick: A silent maniac covered in scars who climbs on tables and chairs and throws himself off them at whoever is standing nearby.
roster.finisher_description: He sets up a chair, springs off it, and drops a leg on the other person through a table.
roster.finisher_move: Springboard leg drop with a chair

roster.ring_name: Tazbo, the Human Suplex Machine Shop
roster.gimmick: A short, scowling grappler in a towel who throws people around like laundry and ends the night with a choke.
roster.catchphrase: Beat me if you can. Survive if I let you.
roster.finisher_description: A choke from behind with the body locked, held until the music stops.

look.name: Tazbo, the Human Suplex Machine Shop

roster.gimmick: A cane-swinging, beer-pouring everyman who takes ten minutes to reach the ring because he walks through the crowd drinking everybody's beer.
roster.finisher_description: A Russian leg sweep off the top rope with a cane across the throat.

roster.gimmick: A powerful former football star who won the big one and now appears out of nowhere at the worst moments to say one word.
roster.finisher_description: He catches them on his shoulder and spins them down.

roster.gimmick_category: The Wrestling God of the Stock Ticker
roster.gimmick: A cowboy-hatted Texan who arrives in a white limousine with steer horns on the bonnet, reads the stock market out loud and clotheslines poor people.
roster.finisher_description: A running lariat with his whole bank balance behind it.

roster.gimmick: The woman who held the belt for so long that nobody can remember anybody else holding it, and who hides the keys whenever somebody asks.
roster.catchphrase: The belt stays with me. So does the money.
roster.finisher_description: She grabs a handful of hair and throws the other woman across the ring.

roster.gimmick: A cackling, cigar-chewing hellraiser who wrestled in the fifties and will flash the crowd or bounce a man off the turnbuckle with equal joy.
roster.catchphrase: I was doing this before your mother was born.
roster.finisher_description: She bounces on a cornered opponent with an alarming look on her face.

roster.gimmick: An athletic cowgirl in a frizzy perm and neon who won the title at the height of the rock and roll craze, with a pop star in her corner.
roster.catchphrase: Girls just want to have title belts.
roster.finisher: The Rollup of Rock and Roll
roster.finisher_description: A rolling crucifix pin out of nowhere.

finishing_moves.name: The Rollup of Rock and Roll

roster.gimmick: A shrieking, sequined menace who manages the most dangerous men in the company and is more dangerous than all of them.
roster.catchphrase: Shut up and let me manage.
roster.finisher_description: A diving splash from the top rope, handbag first.

roster.ring_name: The Cabinet, Ninth Wonder of the Kitchen
roster.gimmick_category: The Ninth Wonder of the Kitchen
roster.gimmick: The strongest woman in the company and much of the men's division, who walks out in leather, wrestles the men, and stores the good plates.
roster.finisher_description: A powerbomb on anybody, of any size, from any height.

look.name: The Cabinet, Ninth Wonder of the Kitchen

roster.gimmick: A strong, gorgeous powerhouse with a gold and black outfit who does the women's division's heavy lifting and charges extra for it.
roster.finisher_description: She lifts them up by both arms and drops them face first.

roster.gimmick: The best women's wrestler many people have ever seen, who bridges like a rainbow and moonsaults off anything with a top to it.
roster.finisher_description: She lifts them over, rolls through and bridges into a pin that looks like a sculpture.

roster.gimmick: A terrifying leader of a gang of punks, with face paint, nunchucks and hair that reaches the ceiling and occasionally the lighting rig.
roster.finisher: The Guillotine Drop From the Rafters
roster.finisher_description: A leg drop from the top rope across the throat, hair following a second later.

finishing_moves.name: The Guillotine Drop From the Rafters

roster.gimmick_category: The Woman Who Binned the Belt
roster.gimmick: An Italian-born flyer who once threw another company's title belt in a bin on live television. She has kept a bin in her corner ever since.
roster.catchphrase: Some belts belong in the bin.
roster.finisher: The German Suplex Into the Bin
roster.finisher_description: A bridging German suplex held for the three.

finishing_moves.name: The German Suplex Into the Bin

roster.gimmick: A quick, spicy technician who flips round her opponents' heads, wraps her legs round the ropes, and keeps a jar of something fermented in her locker.
roster.finisher_description: A flying headscissors that ends with a face driven into the mat.

roster.gimmick: A wide-eyed, unhinged powerhouse in a spider-web costume who swears she is perfectly fine while choking you on the ropes.
roster.finisher_description: She hooks both arms, lifts them up her back and drops them.

teams.name: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalunch
